comment: No source is published. Both signals are mapped to unsigned 16-bit numbers, combined with exclusive-or and with and, mapped back to -1 to 1 and put through a one-pole lowpass at 11kHz before the output; the exclusive-or and multiplying outputs also go through a hyperbolic tangent, the and output does not. The frequency knob is configured -8 to 12 with a display base of 2, so two raised to that, and process adds the pitch jack to it before the power of two. The internal oscillator is a sine: its mode field is set to zero in the constructor and the LFO dispatches zero to sinf. The two exclusive-or and and paths share one filter state, so each interferes slightly with the other.
